findings_qualitative.value: Blueshifted spot at the zeroth-moment peak, a signature of infall, in all CH3CN K components and SO2 lines

evidence.quote: show a central spot of blueshifted emission, with respect to the systemic velocity of the cloud, located at the peak of the zero-order moment

claims.hypothesis: Is the HC HII region surrounded by a hot, rotating, infalling molecular core?
claims.experiment: CH3CN and SO2 moment maps, channel maps, PV diagrams, rotational diagrams and infall model fit
claims.result: Velocity gradient 1.1 km/s/arcsec, blue spot, T_rot 252 to 166 K, central mass 172.8 Msun
claims.finding: A compact hot molecular core is rotating and infalling toward a central mass, likely confining the ionized gas

evidence.quote: We conclude that the HC H ii region is surrounded by a compact structure of hot molecular gas, which is rotating and infalling

claims.hypothesis: Is the molecular core internally heated?
claims.result: T_rot falls with distance as r^-0.35
claims.finding: Hot core internally excited by the central star

evidence.quote: The rotational temperature decreases outwards with distance from the "blue spot"

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Far distance 14.7 kpc rejected as implausible

evidence.quote: Choosing the far distance not only results in an unrealistically massive cluster

limitations_admitted.value: Errors do not include distance uncertainty or density gradients

evidence.quote: The errors do neither include the distance uncertainty nor potentially strong density gradients

Lack of an explicit fitting method and error treatment
